explanation: The value is 0 everywhere except at D2 on a rare transition after choosing a1 (a1 led to S2), when the previous trial was rewarded and was not itself a rare a1-to-S2 trial; if the previous trial was unrewarded it stays at 0. Its size depends on time in the episode: about 9-10 for trials 85-93, about 4 near trial 96, about 2 near trial 78, and 0 before about trial 75.
